transcript:
MARTIN: Your levels are fine. Keep going...

[DAVID mutters an acknowledgement]

[SFX: He walks through a door into another room.]

DAVID (CONT’D): I am now in what looks to be an office... The rain from outside is streaming in through cracks in the ceiling. There are a couple of old typewriters covered in dust, and rusting.

[SFX: He presses a couple of the keys which clack loudly.]

DAVID (CONT’D): There is some graffiti on the wall here... 

[SFX Martin flushes the toilet]

DAVID: (Breaking from his serious presenter character)... Really?

MARTIN (Laughing): When nature calls.

DAVID: Get back to your desk!

MARTIN: Okay okay... Now, can you say that again? 

DAVID: You're an ass, you know that? Anyway... (back in character) There's some graffiti here... Barely readable... and a couple doors leading out. (NORMAL VOICE) Martin, do you know where they lead?

MARTIN: 	Oh, uh... says here one leads to the cells, one leads to the offices, and there should also be an entrance to the east wing.

DAVID: Yeah... sounds about right.
